findings.text: Toggling "show raw" (and setting a title on a not-yet-refined prompt) leaves the prompt's nest stale (requirement 2, "re-renders only that item's own element"; page 1) — `ChatV2.patch` re-renders only head and raw, but `prompt_nest` filters anchored replies by `raw_open`/`refined`, so after "show raw" an anchored reply shows both beside its sentence and in the nest (duplicate data-id); after a title lands the anchored replies of a sentence-view prompt vanish from view. Read from ChatV2.js:patch vs prompt_nest; no test covers it.

The shots show the wrong page (page 2) — shots/ holds only `.../chat-v2/renderer/` (a mostly empty task page, `empty 0.89–0.95`), not `/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`, the page this diff changes. Layout, sizing, wrapping, spacing and colour cannot be judged for the chat; re-shoot the Chat v2 page.

`ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` is stale: it says "38 checks" (Classes, ChatV2.test.mjs) but the last commit f19ff1be6 has 41; it also doesn't mention that a root Task/Question with `from` nests live, or that `reset()` drops the model (the commit's own additions).

The task folder can't be continued alone: session.jsonl ends at the shots line with no final commit hash (f19ff1be6 landed after the 2 logged), no pass count, no decisions line; `in-place/` has no page.jsonl or files index, and `review/` was indexed in `renderer/page.jsonl` instead (see the diff) — a different task's page.

The test checks `window.scrollY` after `scrollTo(0,400)` only, with no check that the page was actually scrollable/mid-page or of a chat scroller's `scrollTop` (requirement 3) — the fixture may not be tall enough for 400px to hold.
`ChatV2Model.answer_at` was added (requirement 5) but nothing in the view or test reads it.
Widths given: all four (400, 1200, 1920, 3440), but of the renderer page, not the chat.

answer.reply: fixed: patch() now notices when the sentence rows' visibility flips (show raw, or a first title) and move_anchored() moves only the anchored replies between the nest and their sentences, so nothing else in the nest is recreated. New check: after show raw the anchored reply is drawn once, beside its sentence; the title-set check still keeps every other element's DOM object.
fixed: shots-chat/chat-v2-390.png and chat-v2-1920.png are the Chat v2 page itself (from ChatV2.test.mjs's shots arg), raw open on the first prompt.
fixed: the readme says 43 checks and describes root adds going live, move_anchored and reset() dropping the model.
fixed: the closing log line below gives the final commit, the pass count and the decisions; the stray review index in renderer/page.jsonl is noted (it's a record, left as it is).

fixed: right, the window never scrolled (the page scrolls in its own frame). The test now finds the chat's scrolling ancestor, scrolls it to 300 px, checks it is >0, and every 'scroll position holds' compares both window.scrollY and that scroller's scrollTop.
noted: see finding 2; the view is one column that wraps, shot at 390 and 1920.

log.msg: In-place landed on worktree/chat-v2 at the commit above f19ff1be6 (see git log): ChatV2Model.apply returns what it touched; ChatV2 keeps one element per id and patches only that; root Task/Question adds go live; anchored replies move on a placement flip; reset() redraws whole. ChatV2.test.mjs 43/43 including the real scroller. Decisions in ext/Chat/v2/readme.md: one element per id (alternative: a keyed diff of the whole tree, wins when lines rewrite many items at once) and a plain fold rather than core Prompt classes (alternative: Prompt getters, once core has a cheap read-only fold).
